enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe regularly. Remain still. Turn onto left side. Pull blanket. Continue sleeping. Turn onto right side. Adjust pillow. Stretch legs. Bend knees. Remain asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up, showering, and brushing teeth (using the bathroom before Member 2's 06:40-07:00 slot to avoid the conflict)
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up and sit up. Stand and walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet and flush. Turn on shower and adjust temperature. Step into shower and wash body. Rinse and turn off shower. Step out and dry. Pick up toothbrush and apply toothpaste. Brush teeth and rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off light and walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and organizing the work bag while Member 2 uses the bathroom
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe and take out clothes. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up work bag. Open work bag and place laptop and notebook inside. Zip work bag. Check phone for messages. Put phone in pocket.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with Member 2 at the kitchen table
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen and greet Member 2. Open refrigerator and take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator and place items on counter. Pick up bowl and crack eggs into it. Whisk eggs. Place pan on stove and turn on stove. Pour eggs into pan and cook. Turn off stove and place eggs on plate. Toast bread and butter it. Pour milk into glasses. Set table. Sit at table with Member 2. Eat breakfast and drink milk. Talk with Member 2. Finish eating. Pick up plates and carry to sink. Rinse plates and place in dishwasher. Wipe table.

enriched_activities.activity: Final morning preparation: checking work emails on the phone and packing the last items for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Pick up phone. Open email app. Scroll through emails. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open work bag. Check contents. Add charger. Add water bottle. Zip work bag. Pick up keys. Pick up wallet. Put keys and wallet in pocket. Check phone for time. Put phone in pocket. Pick up work bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone away. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to office. Enter building. Greet colleagues. Walk to desk. Sit down.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a community program coordinator at a nonprofit
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Attend meeting. Take notes. Make phone calls. Schedule events. Meet with community partners. Write reports. Prepare materials. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to desk. Continue working. Attend another meeting. Finish tasks. Shut down computer.

Leave office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Look out window. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk home. Enter building. Walk to apartment. Open door. Enter.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner together with Member 2 (joining the meal preparation already in progress)
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Greet Member 2. Wash hands. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Stir pot. Add seasoning. Taste food. Set table. Pick up plates. Place plates on table. Pick up glasses. Fill with water. Place glasses on table. Pick up cutlery. Place cutlery on table. Talk with Member 2. Turn off stove. Carry pot to table.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner with Member 2 and clearing the dishes into the dishwasher together
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at table with Member 2. Serve food. Eat dinner. Drink water. Talk with Member 2. Finish eating. Pick up plates. Carry plates to sink. Scrape food into trash. Rinse plates. Open dishwasher. Place plates in dishwasher. Pick up glasses. Place glasses in dishwasher. Pick up cutlery. Place cutlery in dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Wipe table with cloth. Wipe counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa with Member 2. Pick up remote control. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Select program. Watch TV. Talk with Member 2. Adjust volume. Put down remote. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Continue watching TV. Stretch arms. Adjust sitting position.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV, and using the phone (Member 2 is in Bedroom 2 working on freelance illustration commissions)
enriched_activities.desc: Watch TV. Pick up phone and scroll through social media. Put down phone and watch TV. Pick up remote and change channel. Put down remote. Pick up phone and play game. Put down phone. Stand up and walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator and take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa and eat snack. Watch TV. Pick up phone and check messages. Put down phone. Continue watching TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Unwinding with light reading and a short TV program with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Put down book. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Select short program. Watch TV. Talk with Member 2. Turn off TV. Put down remote. Pick up book. Read more. Close book. Put down book.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening routine: brushing teeth and washing face
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put down toothbrush. Turn on tap. Wash face with water. Apply cleanser. Rinse face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Pick up floss. Floss teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to bedroom. Turn off light. Lie down in bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Breathe regularly. Turn onto left side. Adjust pillow. Stretch legs. Bend knees. Turn onto right side. Pull blanket. Remain still. Continue sleeping.
